name: lookup_savings_balance
description: Look up a member on Horizon Core and return the savings balance shown on the detail screen.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: Member number. On the Northline variant the same value is entered in the field labeled Account ID.

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Savings balance text shown beside Savings balance, including the dollar sign.

outcomes.description: No member is on file for that number. The caller receives this outcome instead of a failed run.
